outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative flow cytometric gating plots with percentages for a single sample; no averaged/summary statistics, error bars, or statistical comparisons are shown, so this is treated as representative data not requiring replicate reporting.
Panel B is a representative flow cytometric gating plot identifying plasma cells (PC) with a single percentage value; no aggregated statistics are shown, so replicate reporting is not required.
Panel C shows a representative gating strategy for NP-specific GC and MBC populations with percentages from a single sample; no summary statistics or error bars are present.

Panel D is a color-coded overlay of representative flow cytometry data (MBC, GC, naive populations) showing marker expression; it is a representative dot-plot overlay without averaged quantification or statistics.
Panel E shows a representative gating plot for MBC subsets with percentages from a single sample; no averaged data, error bars, or statistical tests are shown.
